fields.headline:
2.2
Vector Addition
fields.subhead: Combine two vectors into a single resultant — first at 90°, then at any angle.

imageSubjects.section: two ropes pulling at right angles on a metal ring

fields.headline: Two Ways to Add Vectors
fields.subhead: Same two methods from Unit 1, Section 1.0.
fields.c1_b:
R = √(A² + B²)
theta = arctan(B/A)
Pythagorean shortcut.
fields.c2_b:
Break each into x, y.
Add the x's, add the y's.
Recombine into one R.

fields.headline: Applying It: Plane in a Crosswind
fields.subhead: A 2D-motion example — copy the setup, not just the answer.
fields.problem: A plane flies 80 km/h east into a 20 km/h north crosswind. Find the resultant velocity.
fields.g1_b:
80 km/h, east
20 km/h, north
Perpendicular vectors

imageSubjects.aside: a small propeller plane silhouette against clouds

fields.headline: Plane in a Crosswind, Worked
fields.subhead: Write the direction, not just the number — a resultant with no angle is an incomplete answer.
fields.work:
R = √(80² + 20²) = 82.5 km/h
theta = arctan(20/80) = 14°
Direction: 14° N of E
fields.mustwrite: Always report both magnitude and direction together.
